hypotheses.C0_exact_finite_factorial: Changed destination states and three-factor Shapley allocations recompose to relative error at most 1e-5, and base suffix replays agree with native logits to maximum error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.C1_fresh_attention_constructs_some_cross: At the first audited layer whose destination-only projection reaches 0.50, attention receives at least 0.20 projection share for at least two families.
hypotheses.C2_mlp_is_usually_a_consolidator_not_pri: At that crossing layer, absolute MLP projection share is below 0.20 for at least three families.
hypotheses.C3_terminal_interface_is_carried: At Layer 17, carried-state projection share is at least 0.60 for all four families.
hypotheses.C4_branch_credit_is_interaction_robust: Across family-layer cells with destination projection at least 0.25, singleton and Shapley branch projection signs agree at least 80% of the time.
